title: Caveman middleware sessions/delete response
description: sessions/delete 200 response. A protocol 1.1 runtime sends deleted counts, and originals_deleted true unless the authority holds grants a protocol 1.0 runtime issued (§12); protocol 1.0 runtimes sent originals_deleted false and no counts. Closed on purpose: describes exactly what a protocol 1.1 server emits, and the conformance kit holds servers to it. Clients MUST NOT validate responses against this schema; they ignore unknown fields (docs/technical/middleware-protocol.md §4, §16).
